title: Contextual Drift Scorer and Post-Deploy Embedding Validation
creator: Asha Menon
description:
Motivation: model/config changes (quantization profiles, kernel selection, batching and reranker weights) affect embedding space geometry and reranker recall/precision. We need an automated post-deploy mechanism that scores contextual drift per cohort, runs offline recall/precision probes tied to the exact config change, and gates rollouts when statistically significant degradation is detected.

Goal: implement a Contextual Drift Scorer service + a post-deploy embedding validation harness that: 1) computes cohort-level drift scores (distributional distance + alignment of nearest-neighbor recall), 2) runs targeted offline recall/precision probes using saved ground-truth pairs, 3) publishes a per-change verdict and per-cohort metrics to Console and to our release gating pipeline.

Scope: this ticket covers the scaffolding, scoring algorithms, canary integration, dashboards, and a small set of default cohort probes. Production rollout and long tail of cohorts will be follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: Contextual Drift Scorer microservice deployed to staging that ingests embeddings and computes cohort-level drift metrics within 5 minutes of a deploy event
Offline recall/precision probe runs automatically for each model/config change using the change's snapshot (model weights/config) and produces a numeric delta vs baseline
A gating signal (pass/warn/fail) is emitted and available in the rollout API for canary and automated rollouts
Console dashboard tile shows drift score, recall delta, precision delta, sample examples, and historical trend for the last 30 days
Synthetic test coverage for core scoring functions with > 90% unit coverage and an integration smoke test that runs on CI for deploy artifact verification
tasks: Design data contract for snapshot ingestion (model id, config hash, embedding vector store snapshot reference, cohort id)
Implement drift scoring library: distributional (Wasserstein/KS), cosine centroid shift, and NN-recall delta
Build post-deploy harness that spins up evaluation runner with the exact runtime config used in prod (quantization, kernels, batch shape)
Wire canary integration so the scorer runs automatically on canary traffic and on the staged rollout job
Create Console dashboard (tile + drilldown) and a webhook that posts gating verdicts to the rollout controller
Add example cohort probe sets (search QA pairs, reranker labels, retrieval queries) for three sample customers/internal apps
Run internal smoke run on Dedicated and Private stacks to verify VPC-friendly snapshot loading and KMS access for protected datasets
Document runbook and false-positive triage steps in the team handbook
notes: We intentionally compute multiple orthogonal signals (distributional + NN recall) because single-statistic alarms historically trigger false positives for minor centroid shifts.
Primary storage for historical embeddings will reuse the Cohort Snapshot service; for large cohorts we will sample using stratified time windows to keep evaluation latency manageable.
For initial rollout, thresholding will be conservative (higher tolerance) and provide a warn state rather than automatic rollback.
Consider later adding per-customer adaptive thresholds based on baseline variance (low-variance cohorts get tighter thresholds).
